description: Express.js route definitions for user-related API endpoints, including user listing, project retrieval, tenant summaries, active user trends, and legacy proxy routes, with middleware for tenant extraction and request handling.

classes.name: Object
classes.description: Response-like object used to capture and normalize responses in legacy proxy route.

methods.name: usersEarlyBypassDetector
methods.description: Middleware to detect and bypass user listing for specific tenant 'T0000' before organization/tenant extraction.

methods.name: buildTenantSummaryCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs cache key for tenant summary based on query parameters.

methods.name: buildActiveTrendCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs cache key for active trend data based on query parameters.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached data if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores data in cache with expiration.
